text_block_list.text: "The Splendid Clan"... When hearing that name, people immediately picture a certain Umamusume.
The peerless, legendary Umamusume who carved glorious achievements into history... Inheriting their bloodline, she has blossomed into an even greater flower—
“—Daiichi Ruby. She is the Umamusume who truly embodies the modern 'Noble Lineage.'”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I have finished delivering the report to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Keep moving forward on those legs of yours."
...That is what she told me.

Having concluded three momentous years, Daiichi Ruby
visited her family home today to report
on her future path.

"To reach the ultimate brilliance on my own two legs"—
It seems her resolve has been accepted.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: What were you doing?
choice_data_list: I was looking at a portrait.

text_block_list.text:
When I first visited this house, the pressure of those gazes
almost made my knees buckle, but...
Now, I can welcome it with my head held high.
choice_data_list: (I must have made a contribution, surely.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Allow me to introduce myself once again.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: You have served admirably throughout these past three years.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I imagine that becoming my Trainer
has been a continuous series of trials and tribulations.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: However, you made a sincere effort and grew because of it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Magnificently done.
You have my gratitude.

Daiichi Ruby's words of appreciation touch my heart.
Starting from an unworthy position, we've come so far...
And she has been watching that entire journey.

I tell her this with all my heart.
Perhaps Daiichi Ruby is planning to change Trainers in the future...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
From here on, as the symbol of the 'Illustrious Family',
I must constantly remain a shining presence.

For that sake, I want to sign a contract with a
more capable Trainer. If such an offer were
to come up, then at that time—
choice_data_list: (I'll tell her that I'll become an even better Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
let's discuss our upcoming schedule.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I'm having trouble discerning your intention.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Is it not a Trainer's job to decide race schedules?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "In that case, please focus. Time is finite, after all."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...You must stay and watch until the day
my portrait hangs alongside the others over there.

After having a brief meeting with Daiichi Ruby
and returning to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah, here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady!
Welcome baaack~~☆

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm here to hit on the young lady♪

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, we're actually about to
go hang out now, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I was waiting around because I heard Ruby might be back soon.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but
I have training after this.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right?
Ojo is so totally that~☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you already understood that I would decline,
then why did you wait for me?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Still, you never know, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know, but
maybe someday they'll say yes, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: The weather and people's moods can change at the drop of a hat, after all!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —A change.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If it's for training, no can do, I guess!
I'll invite ya again next time♪

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Next time you invite me,
please prepare a few candidate dates."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I will consider it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll LANE you all my free days!
Add Miracle to the group LANE too!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for giving me something so fun to look forward to, Ruby!

Having gone through three momentous years, Daiichi Ruby
has also gradually... ever so slightly, begun to change.

Throughout all of it, one thing has remained consistent from the start.
Her fierce devotion to her family—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Then please wait on the track.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There will surely be many challenges ahead.
Even so, please make sure never to forget to protect it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Be brilliant. Be supreme.
Always shine the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That beautiful—golden rule of "mine."
